long_biography.plain_text:
Fine-arts training shapes Vasilis Dragnis's work at the family shipbuilder, where product planning joins interior design, decoration and marketing. He also earned an MBA in shipping management, pairing visual judgement with commercial discipline. His contemporary-art collection has included commissioned works selected to support the design language of large custom projects.

Dragnis helped acquire and develop new shipyard facilities in Piraeus, then oversaw construction programmes as the business moved into larger custom projects. The purpose-built yard brought steel fabrication, piping, electrical, mechanical and hydraulic work together in-house. He has also promoted wastewater treatment and exhaust-filtration systems as part of the company's emphasis on environmental performance and technical certification standards.
